result.title: Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
result.summary: Collecting and labeling inertial measurement unit (IMU) data for human activity recognition (HAR) is expensive, and models trained on one group of subjects often fail to generalize to unseen individuals. Even with balanced data, classifiers struggle to distinguish dynamically similar activity classes and benefit from targeted augmentation. We explore whether synthetic IMU data generated in the representation space of a pretrained biosignal encoder, Bio-PM \cite{b1}, can serve as a practical augmentation source. Rather than synthesizing raw signals, we leverage Bio-PM's frozen encoder to convert 10-second IMU windows into token embedding sequences and train class-conditional decoders in this space: (1) an autoregressive transformer decoder that predicts tokens sequentially, and (2) a diffusion decoder that learns the token distribution through a denoising objective. We analyze generation realism through distributional metrics and embedding-space visualizations, evaluate downstream utility through leave-one-subject-out HAR classification, and present a PatchDecoder for approximate raw waveform reconstruction. Our diffusion decoder achieves a Train-on-Synthetic-Test-on-Real (TSTR) macro-F1 of 0.68, demonstrating that generated tokens are realistic enough to train a classifier that transfers to real data. Combining synthetic-token augmentation with a 320-dimensional gravity-aware feature representation raises LOSO macro-F1 from 0.729 to 0.809 over a real-only baseline across 51 subjects on the WISDM benchmark, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the most challenging activity classes. These results demonstrate that high-fidelity generation in a pretrained encoder's representation space is achievable and practically useful for cross-subject HAR augmentation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在预训练生物信号编码器 Bio-PM 的冻结表示空间中合成 IMU 数据：分别训练自回归 transformer 解码器与扩散解码器逐段生成 token 序列，用分布指标和嵌入可视化评估真实性，并以留一被试 HAR 分类、TSTR 及 PatchDecoder 波形重建检验下游可用性。
AI.relevance_reason: 「冻结编码器潜空间 + 自回归/扩散两种生成器」的对照及其对生成 token 真实性与可解码性的评价方式，可能可供核查 LVR 中 latent 推理状态如何生成、如何判定保真度，但任务域为传感器信号，迁移线索需较多核查。
